passage: The team originally planned to build a custom search engine for the knowledge base. A two-week prototype showed that an existing service meets accuracy and privacy requirements at one-third the projected first-year cost. Engineering recommends buying the service and using the saved quarter to improve article quality and search analytics.

keyPoints.text: Engineering recommends buying an existing knowledge-base search service instead of building one.
The service meets accuracy and privacy requirements at one-third the first-year cost.
The saved quarter will go to article quality and search analytics.

referenceAnswer: Buy the existing knowledge-base search service: it meets requirements at one-third the cost and frees a quarter for content improvements.
